steps.en: Build it (or install a package or the official image) and start the server
steps.zh: 编译（或装发行版包、官方镜像），启动服务端

steps.en: Keeps every key in memory and speaks the Redis wire protocol on the usual port
steps.zh: 把所有键放在内存里，在常用端口上说 Redis 协议

steps.en: Point your existing Redis client at it — the commands do not change
steps.zh: 把现有的 Redis 客户端指过来，命令不用改
steps.code: set foo bar · get foo · incr mycounter

steps.en: Answers each command from memory, applying data-structure operations atomically
steps.zh: 直接从内存应答每条命令，数据结构操作原子执行

value.en: A drop-in, BSD-licensed Redis replacement for caches, sessions, counters and queues
value.zh: 可直接替换 Redis、BSD 许可的内存库，用于缓存、会话、计数器和队列

sources: https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey README (Building Valkey: make; Running Valkey: ./valkey-server, --replicaof 127.0.0.1 6379; Playing with Valkey: set foo bar / get foo / incr mycounter; Installing: redis-server/redis-cli compatibility symlinks)
https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey README header (forked from Redis right before the source-available license change; key/value data structure server)
